PR (cited in the notes as #21829): fix(ui, rbac): project-roles [closed; labels ready-for-review]
This PR builds upon the PR done in #12853. The only real difference to the prior PR is that this adds support for `applicationsets` as well as all other project-scoped resources (`clusters`, `applications`, `repositories` etc etc). In order to ensure that future rbac policies are in sync I wanted to make use of the project-scoped map in `rbacpolicies`, but since that led to circular build dependency issues I needed to move that to the `rbac` package, which makes this PR look more substantial than …

Otherwise as the previous PR, this adds support for displaying/adding resources other than `applications` to the project roles UI.

Closes #12852
